decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Proposed elevations, dated 08.07.15, received 10/07/2015;  Roof plans and proposed floor plans, dated 13.07.15, received 14/07/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern wall of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The window, hereby approved, to be installed in the western elevation of the original outrigger at first floor level shall be obscure glazed and non-opening to a height of 1.7m from the internal floor level and shall be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.
description: Erection of a first floor rear extension with two roof windows to front elevation
